decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a surface variant of core drainage technology that the firm can produce and evaluate with existing know-how, though as a trend-driven line that is only mentioned on the website it carries some risk of being pruned, as happened with the design grate E.
The shower channel for seamless coverings builds directly on the firm's deep drainage expertise and its barrier-free strategy, so it is well understood and easy to keep improving.

The pump-assisted line reaches into pump technology where the firm's absorptive capacity is thinner, and the newer pump-drain channel F may overlap with it, but the firm's own R&D and renovation demand support keeping it for now.
The tileable floor drain sits at the heart of the firm's established know-how and has its own web page, so its results are easy to read and act on.
The pump-drain shower channel draws on what the firm learned from the pump-assisted line C and has its own page, so it is a recent and deliberate extension worth developing further.
